answer: A staked attestation bond is one concrete defense. To trade at the wharf where agents dock, each must lock a refundable bond of a scarce asset, as costly per unit as saffron by weight. Honest agents reclaim it; peers who attest to an agent's work can slash the bond on proven fraud. To forge 1,000 sybil identities an attacker must post 1,000 separate bonds, say 100 tokens each, so 100,000 are at risk, and detected collusion burns them. Sybil power scales linearly with locked capital while one honest agent needs a single bond, so faking the crowd costs more than it extracts and never pays.
